arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# First percentage change: Feb first week to Apr last week
feb_first = 6.71  # First available week in February
apr_last = 6.69   # Last available week in April

pct_change_1 = ((apr_last - feb_first) / feb_first) * 100
abs_pct_change_1 = abs(pct_change_1)
print(f'Feb to Apr: {feb_first} -> {apr_last}')
print(f'Percentage change: {pct_change_1:.4f}%')
print(f'Absolute percentage change: {abs_pct_change_1:.4f}%')

# Second percentage change: July first week to Sept last week
july_first = 6.73  # First available week in July
sept_last = 6.52   # Last available week in September

pct_change_2 = ((sept_last - july_first) / july_first) * 100
abs_pct_change_2 = abs(pct_change_2)
print(f'\nJuly to Sept: {july_first} -> {sept_last}')
print(f'Percentage change: {pct_change_2:.4f}%')
print(f'Absolute percentage change: {abs_pct_change_2:.4f}%')

# Ratio of absolute percentage changes
ratio = abs_pct_change_1 / abs_pct_change_2
print(f'\nRatio (Feb-Apr / July-Sept): {ratio:.4f}')
print(f'Rounded to one decimal: {ratio:.1f}')
"
